entries.name: RGT-075 / RGT001-075
entries.stage: Completed Phase 2a and Phase 2b registry records; no registry-posted results
entries.summary: RGT-075 is Regor's investigational once-daily oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist. Regor reported Phase 2a topline observations from a 73-participant, 12-week study. The sponsor-submitted registry also records the separate 267-participant COMO-1 Phase 2b study as completed on 6 November 2025; neither registry record has posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for RGT-075 for weight management or another indication.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed research evidence.
entries.supply: Completed US research and sponsor announcements do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The Phase 2a weight, adverse-event and discontinuation figures are sponsor-reported topline observations; ClinicalTrials.gov has no posted results for that record. Regor's January 2025 announcement expected COMO-1 topline data by the end of 2025, but the reviewed sponsor-submitted Phase 2b record only establishes completion and has no posted results. Regor's current public pipeline still labels Phase II trials in progress, so the dated registry completion and undated pipeline wording are retained without inferring a Phase 3 start, positive Phase 2b outcome, clinical benefit, comparative tolerability, UK authorisation, NHS access or supply.

discoveryPass.method: Separate current-date and broader undated topic searches covered regulator, NHS, registry and original sponsor sources, smaller developers, oral treatments, combinations, muscle preservation and specialist indications. Results were reconciled with current main and all open pull requests before publication selection.
discoveryPass.included: RGT-075 is a distinct smaller-developer oral GLP-1 programme absent from the live catalogue and dated publication receipts. The Phase 2a and COMO-1 Phase 2b records are separate studies and are not counted as separate medicines.
discoveryPass.rejectedLead: NCT07204171/MG001 was excluded after primary-context review: it concerns mitragynine research for opioid use disorder, not weight management; a search result's phrase 'oral MG001' was not treated as obesity evidence.
discoveryPass.notDuplicated: DA-302168S, NNC0662-0419, CMS-D008, ALV-100, aleniglipron, RGT-075-adjacent oral GLP-1 programmes, COURAGE and bimagrumab were checked against live entries and receipts. Draft PR 874 remains separate retatrutide review work.
incompleteChecks: No public sponsor Phase 2b topline announcement or registry-posted COMO-1 results were located; completion is not treated as a positive outcome.
The sponsor pipeline page displays no publication or update date and appears less current than the dated registry completion records.

Search indexing can lag and selected results cannot exclude older omissions, unannounced programmes or additional international developers. Catalogue and configured-source counts do not establish industry completeness.
